Visibility and Tracking

การแจ้งเตือนเหตุการณ์

A real-time alert or message to stakeholders about a key occurrence in the movement or handling of a shipment, as captured by transport documents, tracking, or regulatory systems.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A real-time alert or message to stakeholders about a key occurrence in the movement or handling of a shipment, as captured by transport documents, tracking, or regulatory systems.

Operational example

The system sends an event notification to the consignee when the cargo arrives at the port, as recorded in the transport management system.
